messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A low-slung quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile with a broad, flat pale pink head with a rounded snout, large dark eyes, and six pink feathery external gill stalks behind the head. Its underside, neck, head and stout limbs are pale pinkish-white wrinkled soft skin, while its back, upper sides and the top of its long tapering tail are covered in dense overlapping large brown-gray rounded scales. It stands on four short amphibian-like legs with small clawed toes, and its thick tail extends to the left beyond the edge of the image.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat pale pink axolotl-like head with rounded snout", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right of the body"}, {"looks_like": "large round black eyes with pale rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head, one prominently visible on the near side"}, {"looks_like": "small pink dot nostril and wide straight slit mouth", "part": "snout and mouth", "where": "at the tip and lower front of the head"}, {"looks_like": "pink stalks with dense feathery red filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "protruding from behind the head and neck, three on the near side and three on the far side"}, {"looks_like": "short stout pale pink wrinkled amphibian limbs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the torso, two front and two hind"}, {"looks_like": "small feet with slender pointed toes tipped with tiny dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs touching the ground"}, {"looks_like": "large overlapping brown-gray pangolin-like keratin scales", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the back and upper sides from the neck to the tail and the top of the tail"}, {"looks_like": "pale pinkish-white wrinkled soft skin", "part": "skin", "where": "on the head, sides of neck, underbelly, and legs"}, {"looks_like": "long thick tapering tail, scaled on top and smooth pale underneath", "part": "tail", "where": "extending to the left from the rear of the body and cropped by the image edge"}, {"looks_like": "small scattered gray-brown speckles", "part": "markings", "where": "on the top and sides of the head"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
